title: Add session goal metadata tests
objective: Lock how Goal is saved, merged, loaded, and resumed through session metadata.
context: Codex-style durability requires Goal to survive normal session lifecycle saves.
Claude Code restores active goals on resume but not achieved or cleared goals; this repo can persist all states but should only reactivate active or paused states.

source_evidence.note: SessionMeta is the persisted sidecar metadata for a session.
SaveMeta merges partial metadata and must preserve Goal when unrelated fields update.

include: Round-trip active Goal through SaveMeta and LoadMeta/GetMeta paths.
Preserve Goal when SaveMeta updates unrelated fields.
Define resume behavior for active, paused, achieved, blocked, and cleared states.
exclude: Do not update TUI lifecycle saves.

implementation_steps: Use temp repositories and existing session helpers.
Assert JSON fields are stable and omit empty values where expected.
Assert unrelated SaveMeta calls do not erase an existing Goal.
deliverables: Failing session metadata tests for Goal.
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail only because SessionMeta lacks Goal support.
Tests do not require real provider calls.
Resume behavior is explicit enough for REPL wiring tasks.
risks: Session repository APIs may not expose a direct LoadMeta helper in every path.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests that prove Goal persists in SessionMeta, survives SaveMeta merge, and has explicit resume/reactivation semantics. Do not implement production code.
notes_for_assignee: Use existing session test style; avoid adding new helpers unless tiny.
